provider-credentials.title: Provider credentials
provider-credentials.description: API keys this Workspace uses with real providers (BYOK): image generation and competitor ad data. Keys are encrypted at rest and never shown again; only Owners can change them.
provider-credentials.list-unavailable: The stored credentials could not be loaded.
provider-credentials.provider-hint: Saving a key does not call the provider or verify that the key works. A configured model cost ceiling and budget are still required before generation.
provider-credentials.label: Label
provider-credentials.key-hint: Paste a key from {{source}}. It is sent once to this workspace and stored encrypted.
provider-credentials.saved-not-bound: The key was saved but could not be enabled for generation. Use "Use for generation" to try again.
provider-credentials.command-unresolved: The request did not complete. Reload the status before trying again.
provider-credentials.market-data-hint: Used for competitor ad scans, not for generation. Saving checks the key's credit balance with ScrapeCreators, which costs no credits; a key that is invalid or has no credits left is not saved. Every resolve and scan is still quoted and confirmed before credits are spent.
provider-credentials.market-data-terms: Scans call ScrapeCreators with your own account and key. Your use of ScrapeCreators is governed by your agreement with ScrapeCreators; MarketAI does not resell or pay for its credits.
provider-credentials.market-data-unverified-hint: This key has no successful balance check. Replace it to check it again.
provider-credentials.market-data-saved-not-bound: The key was checked and saved but could not be enabled for competitor scans. Use "Use for competitor scans" to try again.

meta-connection.title: Meta Connection
meta-connection.description: Connect your Workspace to a Meta ad account for experiments and scale monitoring.
meta-connection.list-unavailable: The Meta connection status could not be loaded.
meta-connection.create-refused: The Meta connection was not created.
meta-connection.create-unresolved: The connection request did not complete. Check the status before trying again.

spend-guardrail.title: Spending limits
spend-guardrail.description: Real provider calls reserve their maximum cost against these limits before they start; controlled Mock never counts. A call that would go over any limit is refused.
spend-guardrail.read-unavailable: The spending limits could not be loaded.
spend-guardrail.owner-only: Only the Workspace Owner can change these limits.
spend-guardrail.invalid-value: Enter a number of 0 or more.
spend-guardrail.above-platform: The platform allows at most {{limit}} here.
spend-guardrail.kind-lower: Lower limits apply to new calls as soon as you save. Calls already sent are not cancelled.
spend-guardrail.kind-raise: Raising a limit lets this Workspace spend more, so you confirm it a second time.
spend-guardrail.save-refused: The new limits were not saved.
spend-guardrail.save-unresolved: The change did not complete. The limits shown were read again; check them before trying again.
spend-guardrail.raise-description: Raising a limit lets this Workspace spend more on real provider calls. Check the change before you confirm it.
